description_en: Queries the Network Intelligence Service (NIS) traffic ranking analysis results
description_zh: 查询NIS流量排序分析结果
name: DescribeNisTrafficRanking

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic ranking analysis result returned by the StartNisTrafficRanking operation
parameters.help_zh: 流量排序分析结果 ID，根据StartNisTrafficRanking接口返回进行传入
parameters.name: nis_traffic_ranking_id

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

FlowRankingList.description_en: The list of traffic ranking analysis results
FlowRankingList.description_zh: 流量排序分析结果列表

BindingResourceId.description_en:
The instance resource to attach the EIP.
This field is returned only when Internet Shared Bandwidth metric analysis is queried
BindingResourceId.description_zh:
EIP 所绑定的实例资源。
当查询共享带宽指标分析时，该字段才会返回

BindingResourceType.description_en:
The type of the instance resource to which the EIP is bound.
This field is returned only when Internet Shared Bandwidth metric analysis is queried.
Valid values:
      - EIP_ECS: ECS instance
      - EIP_ENI: Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance
      - EIP_NAT: NAT gateway instance
      - EIP_SLB: elastic network interface (ENI)
      - HAVIP_ECS: high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP)
      - TARGET_IP: IP address
BindingResourceType.description_zh:
EIP 所绑定的实例资源类型。
当查询共享带宽指标分析时，该字段才会返回。
枚举有：
      - EIP_ECS：云服务器ECS实例类型
      - EIP_ENI：负载均衡SLB实例类型
      - EIP_NAT：NAT网关实例类型
      - EIP_SLB：弹性网卡实例类型
      - HAVIP_ECS：高可用虚拟IP类型
      - TARGET_IP：IP类型
